title: Round 2: green worlds for zahraasadeq.dev
question: Every earlier option is gone. These are new directions built around green, with bold editorial type. Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Field Guide
options.lineage: Naturalist field guides and herbarium specimen plates
options.thesis: Your work catalogued like a field guide: each product a full-color specimen plate, named in huge bold type, with a collector's tag giving the habitat (stack), date, and field notes on how it works.
options.viewport: A cover plate: ZAHRAA SADEQ in massive type over a deep forest-green field, the subtitle 'A field guide to an AI engineer', and plate index 01 Nesvia / 02 Swazona Media / 03 Raytheon to AI. Résumé and email sit on the collector's tag.
options.risk: Botanical cues could soften the technical read if the plates show leaves instead of systems; the specimens must be diagrams of real architecture.

raised.raise: Each specimen plate carries a measured grid with real numbers (data sources, agents, years), like a graticule.
Color commits at block scale: whole plates in solid green fields, never a green accent on white.
One frame system runs the whole site; nav is the index tab on the plate edge, not a generic top bar.

options.label: Circuit Board
options.lineage: PCB solder mask, silkscreen and copper traces
options.thesis: The site is a circuit board: solder-mask green ground, white silkscreen type, and copper traces that draw themselves as you scroll, routing from your Raytheon embedded work into the AI products.
options.viewport: Your name in huge silkscreen-white type on board green, with component designators (U1 NESVIA, U2 SWAZONA) and a trace leading down the page.
options.risk: The most literal 'electrical engineer' idea; it can tip into theme-park if the traces don't carry real information.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.thesis: Phosphor-green traces on dark glass; each product is a channel, and the hero waveform settles when you 'trigger' it.
options.viewport: A live canvas waveform behind ZAHRAA SADEQ in condensed instrument caps.
options.case: Speaks to your ECE background and is very green, but it is dark and techy rather than editorial.

options.label: Block Identity
options.thesis: Loud grass-green bars and product screenshots snap together on a strict module; bold, graphic, confident.
options.viewport: Oversized green bars crossing your name and a tilted Nesvia screen.
options.case: Bold and editorial, but less tied to who you are.
options.risk: Can look like a design agency instead of an engineer.

options.label: Starship Console
options.kept: One frame system that is the whole grid.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.viewport: One line of bitmap text over a black void.
options.case: Not your world; hard to read.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, modern developer portfolio in green, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name, one-line role, CTA buttons, then a project grid.
canonCard.risk: Looks like most other portfolios by design.
